raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Part 05 of 21 of the LoRA runtime stack (branch `lora-stack-04-dense-tables`, base `lora-stack-03-dense-plans`). The stack is cut from the development branch of #42284.

## What this part adds

Add the tuned sm90 and sm100 dense plan tables. A device without a table keeps
the in-code defaults.

Tests: the shipped vocab plans keep the supported execution contract, the
Blackwell routed rows, and the H200 serial in_proj exceptions.

## Verification

- H200 run r41 (2026-10-19): the tree of upstream main `33dd8f6a2eee` plus parts 01–05 imports every module this part changes and passes this part's tests together with every earlier part's unit tests: **143 passed, 20 warnings in 35.05s**.
- `pre-commit` passed on the changed files of every part; `pre-commit run --all-files` passed on the complete stack tree.

The complete 21-part tree equals the development branch of #42284 at `4e92ccf664` (the `5f1092b446` tree rebased onto upstream main `33dd8f6a2eee`; the three engine commits are unchanged apart from the dense commit's conflict resolutions in the runner imports, the decode-graph warmup hook and the MLA-correction imports) minus the benchmark tools and the Triton MoE tuning tables, which follow in separate PRs.

Previous: #42871 · Next: #42873
